description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You spend 1 action holding a prepared Graft without throwing it.

The Graft’s damage dice increase by 2 and its save DC increases by 1. If you take damage while holding it, attempt a DC 11 flat check; on a failure it goes off in your own square instead.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Holding" a consumable mid-throw as a tracked state, and dynamically bumping a homebrew item's damage dice/DC while held, has no selector -- this requires state-tracking a macro would normally handle, not a rule element.
